citations.quote: metastatic non‑small cell lung cancer (adenocarcinoma) harboring an EGFR exon 19 deletion.

candidates.description: Presence of a deletion mutation in exon 19 of the Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor (EGFR) gene in the tumor tissue.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Identify if the patient's cancer is described as 'harboring an EGFR exon 19 deletion'.
candidates.measurement_definition: Positive if the tumor is documented as harboring an EGFR exon 19 deletion; negative if the mutation is documented as absent. Absence of mention is not a negative measurement.
candidates.name: EGFR exon 19 deletion
candidates.uncertainty: The specific method of detection (e.g., NGS, PCR) is not specified.

candidates.description: The maximum Standardized Uptake Value (SUVmax) of the primary lung tumor measured by PET imaging prior to radiation treatment.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Extract the numeric value for SUVmax associated with the primary tumor that is specified as 'pre-radiation'.
candidates.measurement_definition: The numeric SUVmax value explicitly identified as pre-radiation.
candidates.name: Baseline primary tumor SUVmax
candidates.uncertainty: The specific PET radiotracer and imaging protocol used to obtain the SUVmax are not provided.

limitations: The evidence is based on a single patient's progress note and imaging report, which may not represent a broad population.
Baseline values are presented in the context of a comparison with post-treatment values rather than as a standalone baseline table.
summary: The evidence provides baseline clinical and molecular characteristics for a patient with metastatic non-small cell lung cancer, specifically highlighting a known EGFR mutation and pre-treatment metabolic activity of the primary lung tumor.
